testFuzz_BoundedLifecycle_16Buyers(uint1.details: For each step we track running totals and verify solvency + totalLiability.      `claimSeed` drives which members claim between consecutive joins.

testFuzz_ShareOf_PureMath_WideRange(uint.details: Fuzz share invariants across [2..16] with large but non-max C values      to avoid needing enormous mock balances.

test_ClaimFor_FalseReturnTransfer_Preser.details: transfer returns false on claimFor — credit preserved, totalLiability unchanged.

test_ClaimFor_RecipientBlocked_OtherMemb.details: buyer1 is permanently blocked as a transfer recipient throughout the test.      Proves a stuck recipient cannot stall other members:      - buyer1's claim fails while blocked; credit and both liabilities are intact.      - buyer3 joins and buyer4 joins within the cap-4 pool while buyer1 remains blocked.      - buyer2's claim succeeds even while buyer1 is still blocked.      - buyer1's credit grows correctly during the extra joins.      - Only clearing the block at the end lets buyer1 recover their full credit.

test_ClaimFor_WorksAfterCapFilled().details: claimFor works after pool reaches capacity.

test_ClaimFor_WorksAfterDeadline().details: claimFor works after the pool deadline has passed.

test_Join_ExactDeadline_Reverts().details: join at exact deadline must revert (deadline == block.timestamp is "passed").

test_Join_FalseReturnTransferFrom_Rollba.details: transferFrom returns false on join — same rollback.

test_Join_RevertTransferFrom_Rollback().details: transferFrom reverts on join — no membership, no credits, no liability increase.

test_PurchaseFirst_FalseReturnTransferFr.details: transferFrom returns false on purchaseFirst — no membership written.

test_PurchaseFirst_RevertTransferFrom_Ro.details: transferFrom reverts on purchaseFirst — CEI means no state written.

test_Reentrancy_ClaimFor_AssertsSelector.details: Reentry into claimFor during claimFor's transfer (outbound).

test_Reentrancy_Join_AttemptsJoinSamePoo.details: Reentry into join during join's transferFrom.

test_Reentrancy_Join_AttemptsPurchaseFir.details: During a join's transferFrom, the token re-enters purchaseFirst on a second      empty pool. Because join is nonReentrant, the guard fires before purchaseFirst      on pool2 can execute. Asserts exact selector and no phantom state.

test_Reentrancy_PurchaseFirst_AttemptsJo.details: During purchaseFirst's transferFrom, the token re-enters purchaseFirst on a      second REAL empty pool. Both pools are freshly deployed with count==0. CEI on      the outer purchaseFirst writes pool1.count=1 BEFORE the token call, so at      attack time pool2 is still empty (count==0). The guard fires because      purchaseFirst is nonReentrant — pool2.count never changes.      Asserts exact ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall selector; no phantom membership.

test_Reentrancy_PurchaseFirst_AttemptsPu.details: Reentry into purchaseFirst during purchaseFirst's transferFrom.

test_ShareOf_MaxUint256_NoOverflow().details: shareOf handles max uint256 values without overflow.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
